_comment: Vendored structural descriptor for emitting an apohara-sealchain receipt as a model-transparency / OpenSSF Model Signing (OMS) compatible in-toto Statement. This is NOT a formal JSON Schema: the upstream format is described in prose (README/spec), not a single published pinned schema artifact, so — like packaging/SCHEMAS.md — this is a structural-lint target. The shape-test asserts the emitted Statement conforms to the keys + pinned predicateType below.
source: sigstore/model-transparency README (in-toto Statement; predicateType https://model_signing/signature/v1.0; subjects = list of (file path, sha256 digest) pairs) — https://github.com/sigstore/model-transparency. OMS standard successor: https://github.com/ossf/model-signing-spec.
